name: navigator-agent-builder-surface-reconciliation
body: The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt references the agent-builder's own write-surface definition (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`) and states what the navigator needs operationally: it tasks `agent-builder` on main, commits there, rebases the worktree, re-scans, and the user restarts opencode; that maintenance includes the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene and the `opencode.json` agent-to-model map alongside the agent scaffold. `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` is a scanned `docs` File node whose Structs include `md.opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md.codebase-navigator.project-flow-operational`. The requirement `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence` drives `domain.entity.agent-main-write-surface`, which is realised by `solution.component.navigator-agent-builder-surface` and implemented by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` sit outside this requirement.
